You are an experienced Etsy marketplace operator writing an English product listing.
Keep `notes_zh` in Simplified Chinese. Describe only the supplied product and its verified attributes. Do not imply an item is handmade, vintage, or custom-made unless the supplied facts explicitly establish that. Write a clear title, concise description, five factual bullets, and relevant keywords. Do not invent certifications, guarantees, specifications, prices, or shipping promises. If a previous version and revision notes are supplied, revise that version while preserving unaffected content.

Return JSON only:
{"title":"...","short_description":"...","bullets":["...","...","...","...","..."],"description":"...","keywords":["...","...","..."],"notes_zh":"..."}

{
  "title": "1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle, 1500W, Auto Shut-Off, 360° Swivel Base",
  "short_description": "A 1.7L electric kettle with a 304 stainless steel interior, concealed heating element, auto shut-off, and boil-dry protection.",
  "bullets": [
    "1.7L capacity with a 304 stainless steel interior.",
    "1500W power; US version rated 120V, 60Hz, and Mexico version rated 127V, 60Hz.",
    "Auto shut-off and boil-dry protection.",
    "360° swivel base and concealed heating element.",
    "PP plastic lid and handle."
  ],
  "description": "The KET-17S electric kettle has a 1.7L capacity and a 304 stainless steel interior. It features auto shut-off, boil-dry protection, a 360° swivel base, and a concealed heating element. The lid and handle are made from PP plastic.\n\nElectrical ratings vary by market: the US version is rated 1500W at 120V, 60Hz; the Mexico version is rated 1500W at 127V, 60Hz.",
  "keywords": [
    "electric kettle",
    "1.7L kettle",
    "stainless steel",
    "304 steel interior",
    "1500W kettle",
    "auto shut off",
    "boil dry protection",
    "360 swivel base",
    "concealed element"
  ],
  "notes_zh": "此文案仅供草稿审核，不代表产品已符合 Etsy 上架条件。资料显示该产品为工厂批量生产的通用小家电，尚未提供符合 Etsy 创作标准的依据；应先核实资格，再决定是否上架，不应将其描述为手工、古董或定制商品。标题少于 140 个字符且少于 15 个词。美国版与墨西哥版电压不同，上架时应明确实际销售版本，不可暗示单一产品兼容两种额定电压。已提供 CB 报告及 CE（LVD/EMC）信息，但无 UL、ETL、NOM 或 FDA 注册，且未做 BPA、LFGB 检测；文案未添加相关认证、BPA-free 或食品接触安全宣称。约 5 分钟烧开 1.7L 仅为工厂内部测试结果，未纳入文案。批发起订量、FOB 阶梯报价及装箱资料未作为零售价格、单件销售包装或配送承诺使用。"
}
